title: Thomas A ICU 6561/6658/6626 NDE 6561
date: Aug. 23 2011 | Aug. of last year | Aug. 2011
content:
6561 I was raised in church and I know I have failed God a lot of my life, but I always did want to serve God. I have known some very bad people in my life. Mafia people. If I told you what I know, you would wet your pants. At one time, I was offered a job as an enforcer by some very high-ups in the Mafia. I turned them down. I've always been a tough person and have had the ability to be mean when it's been needed. Five days a week, I would go to the gym to lift weights, but this one day, I felt a pain in my chest. I called for help and went downstairs to wait for the fire department to come pick me up and take me to the hospital. I woke up just as I was being cut open. There was blood everywhere and people were screaming at each other. I felt blood spraying my face and tasted the blood on my lips. I heard the saw cut through the ribs in my chest. I felt it all. I was strapped down and not able to move. I felt it all, and I heard everything that was said in the operating room. I knew I was going to die due to the amount of blood there was and how damaged my body seemed to be. My nurse was in a screaming match with her co-workers as well as the nuns, who were holding hands and praying for me. I also saw my wife, who was crying, along with two of our sons. My sons were both were mad about something. I didn't know what they were so mad at, but I could do nothing about it, I was strapped down. I felt my soul leave my body and then I started walking around in the hospital. I saw some hospital staff and listened to them talk about me. They could not see me. They were saying that they didn't think I was going to make it off the operating table alive. Then I found myself walking on a very smooth path that was about twenty feet wide, following the sound of music and angels singing. It was beautiful! I went through very large gates that were made of iron and gold, with small golden figures attached to them. I saw a wall that was made of cut stone. It was very smooth to the touch. I heard a man speaking to me, saying ‘Tommy, come here!’ and it was my grandfather Tom leaning against the wall. He said, ‘Tommy, don't go down there!’ He pointed to the right and I saw a long, wide walkway that sloped in a downward direction. On that walkway, there were hundreds of poor people being dragged along by small men who were attacking them, biting them and beating them as they went. The smell was the worst thing that I have ever smelled. The smell of burning flesh. When I was a child I had smelled that same smell coming from a car crash site that was on fire, but this was far worse than that. As I walked away, I looked back and saw another long walkway from which I could still hear beautiful singing, more beautiful than anything I had ever heard before. However, I walked back out through the gates, turned to the right and proceeded down a long road that was made of cut stone, but very soft to walk on. Next, I found myself back on the operating table covered in blood.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Walking on a very smooth path about twenty feet wide, following the sound of music and angels singing; later a long road/walkway made of cut stone, very soft to walk on.

arrival.other_being_detail: Small men attacking, biting, and beating people on a downward sloping walkway; angels singing were heard.

environment.environment_other_detail: Very large iron-and-gold gates with small golden figures; a smooth cut-stone wall; long wide walkways/roads of cut stone that were soft to walk on; strong smell of burning flesh in one area; beautiful singing/music in another.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: He walked back out through the gates, turned right, proceeded down a long road, and then found himself back on the operating table.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: He heard angels singing/music; saw a distressing downward walkway with people being attacked and the smell of burning flesh; then returned to the operating table.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE in operating room/hospital, then transition by walking paths to gates/walls/walkways with deceased grandfather and other scenes, then return to body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: He reported feeling the surgery in detail while strapped down (blood spraying/tasting blood/hearing saw cut ribs) before his soul left his body; encountered a downward sloping walkway with hundreds of poor people being dragged and attacked, accompanied by an intense smell of burning flesh.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Tommy, come here!” / “Tommy, don't go down there!”
